create.name: John Bruna
create.bio:
John Bruna is a mindfulness and Buddhist meditation teacher who lives in Carbondale, in the Colorado Rockies, with his wife Laura Bartels. He grew up in a large, low-income family after his father's early death, and his young adulthood was marked by drugs, addiction and homelessness until he found recovery in 1984, aged 22. Since then he has worked as a dishwasher, mechanic, manager, school teacher and addictions counsellor, earned a master's in education, and spent years as a Buddhist monk.

He leads the Way of Compassion Dharma Center as its spiritual director, giving Buddhist teachings and retreats, and a co-founder of the Mindful Life Program. On his own site he teaches mindfulness that keeps the Buddhist frame of ethics, concentration and wisdom while staying open to people of any belief or none. His online courses include a six-week programme built on his book The Wisdom of a Meaningful Life, a 28-day course in calm-abiding (shamatha) meditation and a self-paced course on four keys to living mindfully, each with live sessions and priced on a sliding scale. He also meets people one to one for donations, speaks widely, and has given a TEDx talk on free will as a skill.

books.title: The Wisdom of a Meaningful Life: The Essence of Mindfulness
books.author: John Bruna
books.description: His guide to the difference between passing pleasure and lasting contentment. It sets mindfulness back inside the Buddhist trainings in ethics, concentration and wisdom, with everyday examples written for readers of any faith or none.

courses.title: The Wisdom of a Meaningful Life Course
courses.description: A six-week online course drawn from his book, with daily lessons, videos of John explaining the teachings and live Zoom sessions. It works on easing stress and self-criticism and on building a life around values and purpose.
courses.price: Sliding scale: any amount from $99 to $349

courses.title: 28-Day Meditation Training with Live Sessions
courses.description: A month of short daily video and audio teachings that build a steady practice of calm-abiding (shamatha) meditation, for beginners and returning meditators. Weekly live sessions with John are included, and the recordings stay available afterwards.

courses.title: Four Keys of Living Mindfully
courses.description: A self-paced online course with live sessions on four skills of a mindful life beyond sitting practice, aimed at clearer attention, emotional balance and a stronger sense of meaning. Access is unlimited once enrolled.

courses.title: Individual Sessions
courses.description: Thirty-minute conversations in person, by Zoom or by phone, offering guidance on meditation, mindfulness, Buddhist practice and spiritual growth. He is clear that these are not therapy, and they are offered for a donation of any size.

His recovery programmes are left out (see left_out) as programmes sold on overcoming addiction. His home page calls him 'a leading voice in the field of mindfulness and addiction treatment'; that self-description is not repeated.

Individual sessions page says he gives guidance on, among other things, substance use disorder, and states he does not offer therapy; kept as a donation-based guidance session. Owner may prefer to drop it.

Photos: no clean solo headshot on his site. First photo shows him clearly with another person's head in the foreground; second shows him greeting two women at an event. Identity matches across both and the TEDx slide. Owner may want a better photo.
